escape.rationale: The 0.30 mm pad exits join filled GND at U_AMP and the LCD header; the latter also needs a 3.95 mm bottom-layer bridge out of the local ground island.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Dedicated hardware SPI clock from XIAO D8/GPIO7 to 8P ST7789; CS is grounded on this dedicated SPI bus.

LCD_DATA.rationale: Existing display serial data from XIAO D10/GPIO9.

V3V3.rationale: XIAO regulator feeds the screen, microphone and low-level speaker amplifier. 0.5 mm nominal and 0.32 mm at the MSOP fanout.

escape.rationale: MSOP pad is 0.365 mm wide. 0.32 mm external 1 oz trace supports the low-level mono speaker path.

LCD_RES.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D4/GPIO5; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.

LCD_DC.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D5/GPIO6; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.

LCD_BLK.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D6/GPIO43; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.

AMP_EN.rationale: Low-pass average of playback PWM; idle state low.

SPK_P.rationale: Floating BTL speaker lead, red. 0.32 mm end-to-end on 1 oz copper for the attenuated voice-level load.

SPK_N.rationale: Floating BTL speaker lead, black. 0.32 mm end-to-end on 1 oz copper for the attenuated voice-level load.
